poison.name: Poisoned
poison.description: Takes 2 damage at the start of each turn, plus secondary poison damage after 10 rounds unless a Fortitude save succeeds.

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin Protection
antitoxin.description: Grants a +5 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saving throws against poison.

limping.name: Limping
limping.description: Foot wound reduces movement speed until treated with a DC 15 Heal check or 8-hour rest.

sleeping.name: Sleeping
sleeping.description: Asleep and helpless (-10 penalty on Listen checks to wake up).

holy_water_splash.name: Holy Water Splash
holy_water_splash.description: Blessed water sears undead and evil outsiders on contact.
